# #21 — Protocol: two sites generated by an LLM that only has the documentation

Goal: show that **any LLM** builds with BRAINLLM by reading only `llms.txt` + `brain spec`, and measure the result
with reproducible numbers. The LEAD consolidates it in #22; the method and the data live here.

## 1. Sites (briefs frozen in `briefs/*.json`)

| Site | Files the LLM writes | Requires |
|---|---|---|
| `landing` | `comp/feature-card`, `comp/pricing`, `comp/faq`, `comp/contact-form`, `views/index` | `<meta seo>`, monthly/yearly toggle, expandable FAQ, live validation, §8 |
| `panel` | `comp/sidebar`, `comp/kpi`, `comp/client-form`, `comp/client-table`, `views/clients` (`lib/api.js` is provided by the harness) | `load()`, derived KPIs, CRUD with filters, loading/error+Retry/empty (2 variants) states, §8 |

## 2. Generation — `generate.mjs`

Same harness for both engines, so iterations compare 1:1. The harness plays the MCP role:

1. `brain new <run>` (≙ `brain_new`); the scaffold's sample files are removed.
2. Iteration 1: one request per file of the plan, in order; each request carries `llms.txt` + `brain spec` + tokens +
   brief + plan + the files already written. One file per request, because `local-assistant.sh` cuts off at 120 s.
3. `brain check --json` (≙ `brain_check`). For each file with diagnostics: one request with the file and its Diags
   ("apply each `fix`"). Repeats until 0 diagnostics or `--max-iter 6`.
4. Recorded: iterations to 0 · diagnostics and codes per iteration · model / check / total ms · requests · plus the
   QA checker (`phase0/check.mjs` + `a11y-seo/a11y.mjs`) as a second opinion.

| Engine | Model | How | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `claude` | `claude-haiku-5-5` | isolated `claude -p` (empty cwd, fixed system prompt, no tools/settings/MCP) | see `phase0.md` §1 |
| `qwen` | `qwen2.5-coder:7b` (ollama) | `local-assistant.sh code` (`$LOCAL_ASSISTANT` or PATH) | non-Claude model: if it succeeds, the docs stand on their own |

```bash
node bench/sites/generate.mjs --engine claude --site landing
node bench/sites/generate.mjs --engine qwen   --site panel
```

Agentic variant (optional, Claude only): `claude -p` with `--mcp-config` pointing at `brain mcp`, to measure the real
use of the `brain_new/add/check` tools. It does not replace the symmetric run above.

## 3. Site measurement — `measure.mjs`, `hmr.mjs`, Lighthouse

| Metric | Script | Source of the number |
|---|---|---|
| `brain build` cold and warm | `measure.mjs` | `hyperfine -N`, 10 runs; cold removes `dist/` and `.brain` before each run |
| `dist/` rules (§10) | `measure.mjs` | no `.html/.js/.css`; `.br` + `.gz` next to every file; `brain.nginx.conf` |
| Served Content-Type | `measure.mjs` | `brain dev` + `fetch`: `.brain`→`text/html`, `.jsbrain`→`text/javascript`, `.cssbrain`→`text/css` |
| gz bytes per view | `measure.mjs` | page + every `/_b/*` it references, gzip -9 |
| Runtime | `measure.mjs` | gz of the runtime chunk in `dist/` (and of the source as a reference) |
| `brain test` + AX | `measure.mjs` | `brain test --json` (own CDP + `Accessibility.getFullAXTree`) |
| CSS HMR without reload | `hmr.mjs` | the client's `brain:hmr` event: `appliedAt − write`; `performance.timeOrigin` does not change |
| JS HMR with state | `hmr.mjs` | counter at 5 → edit `<script>` → `kind:'js'` and still at 5 |
| ms per component | Debugger log (SPEC §9.1) | once it exists |
| External a11y / SEO | `../a11y-seo/lighthouse.sh <url>` | Lighthouse 13.5.0 via npx, measurement only |
| Visual check | claude-in-chrome, **personal** Chrome | screenshot of each view, desktop and 390 px |

## 4. Runs and report

Each site × engine: 3 runs (`--run <engine>-<site>-rN`). The report (`REPORT.md`) gives the median and the range, and
includes the generated files (`runs/<run>/`) and their `qa-run.json`.

## 5. Dependencies (blocking)

#9 (pack/min: real `dist/`, bytes, minified runtime) · #11 · #13 · #14 · #19 · #7 (codegen: JS HMR with state,
`brain test` green). Meanwhile, every script runs and leaves an explicit `error`/`pending` in its JSON.
